status.emotional_state: knows Ikki chose Stella but cannot abandon her own love

personality.summary: Devoted to Ikki to a frightening degree, sharp-tongued toward Stella, but fundamentally willing to suffer if it helps Ikki's happiness.
personality.inner_conflict: She wants Ikki's happiness more than her own, but cannot simply discard romantic love for him.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Beloved older brother and emotional center; she wants to be the one who makes him happiest.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Romantic rival; she eventually sees why Ikki likes Stella but refuses to formally concede.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Roommate and confidant who takes her drinking and validates her right to keep loving Ikki.
relationships.kagami-kusakabe: News club narrator who later recounts Shizuku's hidden struggle.

periods.summary: Vol-08 reveals Shizuku's interior conflict more directly. On the night Ikki defeats Kirihara, Alice takes her to a bar; drunk, she recounts Ikki's kindness, then admits Stella may be better able to make him happy. Alice tells her she need not discard her love, and that any woman who cannot overcome Shizuku has no right to take Ikki. Later, after Ikki and Stella's relationship becomes public, Shizuku collapses into a messy, game-playing depression. Alice reminds her she can still act as Ikki's family, so she tests Stella's domestic skill and sincerity. Stella passes, and Shizuku says 'please take care of my brother,' but Stella later pretends the test failed so Shizuku need not force herself to relinquish the rivalry.

key_events.summary: Drinks for the first time with Alice and confronts whether she should step aside for Stella.
Tests Stella's right to be Ikki's partner through cleaning, cooking and a direct love question.
